## Common WHERE Filters

所有查询的三要素分区过滤（必须条件）：

```sql
-- 单日查询
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- 多日窗口查询（近7天）
WHERE grass_date <= DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date >= date_sub(DATE('${grass_date}'), 6)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

-- 未来7天窗口查询（回填场景）
WHERE grass_date > DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_date <= date_add(DATE('${grass_date}'), 7)
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

业务过滤：
```sql
-- 仅保留有 rcmd GMV 的 streamer（用于分位排名计算）
AND gmv_rcmd_usd > 0
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

与上游/下游表 JOIN 的核心模式：

```sql
-- 模式 1: 按 streamer + shop 关联有机表现到主播维度
LEFT JOIN org_perf t
  ON a.streamer_id = t.streamer_id
 AND a.shop_id = t.shop_id

-- 模式 2: 带 region 的三键关联
LEFT JOIN org_gmv_after_7d t
  ON a.streamer_id = t.streamer_id
 AND a.shop_id = t.shop_id
 AND a.grass_region = t.grass_region
```

    SUM(gmv_rcmd_ads_usd) AS gmv_rcmd_ads_usd,
    SUM(org_imp_cnt)      AS org_imp_cnt,
    SUM(org_rcmd_imp_cnt) AS org_rcmd_imp_cnt,
    SUM(org_rcmd_ads_imp_cnt) AS org_rcmd_ads_imp_cnt,
    SUM(org_click_cnt)    AS org_click_cnt,
    SUM(org_rcmd_click_cnt) AS org_rcmd_click_cnt,

### Snippet 5: Streamer GMV 分位排名（分层用）

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW org_gmv_tier AS
SELECT
    streamer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0    AND gmv_percentile < 0.01 THEN 'Top 1%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.01 AND gmv_percentile < 0.05 THEN 'Top 5%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.05 AND gmv_percentile < 0.1  THEN 'Top 10%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.1  AND gmv_percentile < 0.2  THEN 'Top 20%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.2  AND gmv_percentile < 0.3  THEN 'Top 30%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.3  AND gmv_percentile < 0.4  THEN 'Top 40%'
        WHEN gmv_percentile >= 0.4  AND gmv_percentile < 0.5  THEN 'Top 50%'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS advertiser_ls_gmv_tier
FROM (
    SELECT
        streamer_id,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY grass_region
            ORDER BY COALESCE(gmv_rcmd_usd, 0) DESC
        ) AS gmv_percentile,
        gmv_rcmd_usd
    FROM (
        SELECT
            streamer_id,
            grass_region,
            SUM(gmv_rcmd_usd) AS gmv_rcmd_usd
        FROM mp_paidads.dws_streamer_livestream_org_performance_1d__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
          AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
          AND tz_type = 'local'
          AND gmv_rcmd_usd > 0
        GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) t
) a
```

### Snippet 6: 有机表现 JOIN 到主播广告指标宽表

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW s0 AS
SELECT
    a.shop_id AS shop_id,
    -- ... (广告表现/收入/标签字段) ...
    COALESCE(gmv_total_usd, 0)         AS gmv_total_usd,
    COALESCE(gmv_rcmd_usd, 0)          AS gmv_rcmd_usd,
    COALESCE(gmv_rcmd_ads_usd, 0)      AS gmv_rcmd_ads_usd,
    COALESCE(gmv_total_usd_today, 0.0) AS gmv_total_usd_after_7d,
    COALESCE(gmv_total_local_today, 0.0) AS gmv_total_local_after_7d,
    a.streamer_id AS streamer_id,
    COALESCE(gmv_total_usd_last_7d, 0) AS gmv_total_usd_last_7d,
    COALESCE(gmv_total_local_last_7d, 0) AS gmv_total_local_last_7d
FROM base_data a
LEFT JOIN org_gmv_after_7d b
  ON a.streamer_id = b.streamer_id
 AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id
 AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
-- ... (后续 LEFT JOIN org_perf, org_gmv_7d) ...
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### 上游数据源

| 上游表 | 用途 |
|--------|------|
| `mp_paidads.dws_ls_session_livestream_org_performance_1d__reg_s0_live` | 主表：按 streamer 聚合 organic 表现（view/time/order/gmv/imp/click） |
| `livestream.ls_mart_dwd_viewer_view_detail_di` | 计算 DAU 的 viewer 事件明细 |
| `livestream.ls_mart_dwd_traffic_ls_session_impression_detail_di` | 计算 DAU 的 impression 事件明细 |

### 生产逻辑摘要

1. 从 `dws_ls_session_livestream_org_performance_1d` 按 streamer_id, streamer_type, shop_id 聚合 session 级别 organic 指标
2. 从 viewer_detail 和 impression_detail 两张原始事件表按 streamer × user 去重计算 dau, rcmd_dau, rcmd_ads_dau
3. LEFT JOIN 合并后用 INSERT OVERWRITE 写入

### Workflow 路径

```
workflows/data_warehouse/dws/livestream/dws_streamer_livestream_org_performance_1d__reg_s0_live/
```

### 分区写入策略

- 每个 region 一个独立调度任务 (ID/MY/PH/SG/TH/TW/VN)
- 写入模式: `INSERT OVERWRITE ... PARTITION(tz_type='local', grass_region, grass_date)`
- tz_type 固定为 'local'
